summary: Serialize array holes and undefined/Function/Symbol elements as null while preserving array length.

target.notes: Array serialization walks integer indices from 0 through length-1 using Get. Missing or otherwise unrepresentable elements contribute the JSON token null rather than being omitted.

semantics.length: captured from the array and all positions are represented
semantics.extra_properties: non-index ordinary properties are not serialized as array members

caveats: This differs from object member omission and from treating a sparse JS array as a compact C# list.

tests.name: hole and unrepresentable elements become null
tests.input: const a=[]; a.length=4; a[1]=undefined; a[2]=()=>1; a[3]=Symbol(); console.log(JSON.stringify(a));
